data.title: Water, Sanitation & Hygiene Behaviour Study
data.short_description: A large Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices (KAP) study on water, sanitation and hygiene, designed to guide behaviour-change and public health work.
data.heading: Water, Sanitation & Hygiene Behaviour Study
data.description:
A large Knowledge, Attitudes and Practices (KAP) study on water, sanitation and hygiene, designed to guide behaviour-change and public health work.

Our Solution & Results

After developing and piloting the survey tools, we ran a baseline survey of 4,000 respondents, delivered behavioural messaging interventions, and followed up with a 4,000-person midline survey. The study also used game-based data collection, snowball-sampled business listings and telephone interviews.

Our custom survey platform with phone integration, live dashboards and built-in QA checks produced accurate, analysis-ready datasets for the programme.
data.challenge_description: UNDP needed reliable evidence on community hygiene habits, and a way to test whether behavioural messages actually changed them.

data.title: Automated Citizen Feedback During COVID-19
data.short_description: Large-scale robocall surveys that captured rapid public feedback on the pandemic's impact to inform timely policy decisions.
data.heading: Automated Citizen Feedback During COVID-19
data.description:
Large-scale robocall surveys that captured rapid public feedback on the pandemic's impact to inform timely policy decisions.

Our Solution & Results

We ran automated mass outreach using multilingual voice-based survey modules to capture citizens' experiences during pandemic disruptions.

Our robocall infrastructure handled more than 250,000 automated calls per day, with automatic response recording, live dashboards and structured data exports for reporting.
data.challenge_description: During the pandemic, decision-makers needed fast, wide-reaching citizen input. Traditional surveys were too slow and face-to-face contact was restricted.

data.title: Measuring Development Impact in the Merged Areas
data.short_description: Eleven specialised telephone surveys that measured the results of development programmes in Energy, Skills, Mining and Governance.
data.heading: Measuring Development Impact in the Merged Areas
data.description:
Eleven specialised telephone surveys that measured the results of development programmes in Energy, Skills, Mining and Governance.

Our Solution & Results

We ran 11 surveys over three phases, with gender-sensitive participation strategies, structured enumerator training, pilot testing and ongoing quality supervision.

Our telephone survey system provided automated dialling, multilingual questionnaires, real-time incentive payments, live monitoring and QA validation, so every phase produced reliable results.
data.challenge_description: The programme needed trustworthy data on whether its interventions were working, collected inclusively across a large and remote region.

data.title: Flood Impact Assessment Across 14 Districts
data.short_description: A telephone survey of 12,000 people that gave UNDP citizen-level data to plan flood recovery in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Merged Areas.
data.heading: Flood Impact Assessment Across 14 Districts
data.description:
A telephone survey of 12,000 people that gave UNDP citizen-level data to plan flood recovery in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa's Merged Areas.

Our Solution & Results

We completed 4,000 interviews for each of three questionnaire variants (A, B and C). The process included pilot testing, enumerator training, structured QA review and live monitoring access for UNDP representatives.

Our survey platform, supervision dashboards and export tools delivered clean datasets ready to inform recovery and rehabilitation planning.
data.challenge_description: After the floods, recovery planners needed fast, accurate information from affected households across 14 districts.

data.title: Evidence for Programme Decisions: Sector Surveys
data.short_description: A series of 11 telephone surveys under UNDP's Merged Areas Governance Programme, producing impact data to international standards.
data.heading: Evidence for Programme Decisions: Sector Surveys
data.description:
A series of 11 telephone surveys under UNDP's Merged Areas Governance Programme, producing impact data to international standards.

Our Solution & Results

Using our own survey software, with automated dialling, multilingual questionnaires, live monitoring and validation, we ran surveys in Energy & Power, Skills Development, Mines & Minerals and Governance across baseline, midline and endline phases.

The project delivered high-quality datasets, impact insights and structured reports aligned with international development standards.
data.challenge_description: Programme managers needed high-quality datasets and clear reporting to judge progress across four sectors over several years.

data.title: Keeping Children in School: Education Outreach
data.short_description: A multi-channel engagement programme that helped reduce school dropouts after grade five in District Chiniot.
data.heading: Keeping Children in School: Education Outreach
data.description:
A multi-channel engagement programme that helped reduce school dropouts after grade five in District Chiniot.

Our Solution & Results

We used CATI telephone surveys to identify at-risk families, followed by targeted robocalls, WhatsApp messages and SMS reminders. High-risk cases were escalated and followed up, with script checks, live monitoring, automated validation and secure data handling throughout.

The project reached more than 200 families and strengthened their intent to keep children in school. OPM formally recognised the team for effective implementation.
data.challenge_description: Many students in the district left school after grade five. The programme needed to find at-risk families and encourage them to keep children enrolled.

data.title: Citizen Trust in Public Services
data.short_description: A 16,000-interview telephone survey measuring how citizens in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and FATA view government service delivery.
data.client_industry_text: PCNA Implementation Support Unit, P&D Department, FATA Secretariat · Government
data.heading: Citizen Trust in Public Services
data.description:
A 16,000-interview telephone survey measuring how citizens in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and FATA view government service delivery.

Our Solution & Results

We conducted 16,000 interviews using random mobile subscriber selection and geographic quotas for proportional representation. Respondents chose their preferred language and received incentives as soon as they finished.

Automated dialling, live supervision dashboards, telecom balance-transfer APIs for incentives and call recording for compliance kept the project accurate and transparent.
data.challenge_description: The government needed a fair, representative picture of public trust across many tehsils and frontier regions to improve its governance models.

data.title: Evaluating Energy, Skills & Governance Programmes
data.short_description: Structured telephone surveys that evaluated Special Emphasis Programmes under the Accelerated Implementation Programme (AIP I & II).
data.client_industry_text: Merged Areas Governance Programme (MAGP), Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa · Government
data.heading: Evaluating Energy, Skills & Governance Programmes
data.description:
Structured telephone surveys that evaluated Special Emphasis Programmes under the Accelerated Implementation Programme (AIP I & II).

Our Solution & Results

We designed and ran surveys for each intervention area, supported by real-time monitoring and validation checks.

The validated datasets and insights now support MAGP's planning and programme refinement, strengthening accountability and informing policy across the Merged Areas.
data.challenge_description: The government needed evidence on whether off-grid solar, youth skills, mining livelihoods and district governance initiatives were delivering results.

data.title: Large-Scale Governance Feedback Survey
data.short_description: A proactive survey of around 16,000 citizens that helped government stakeholders review and strengthen service delivery.
data.client_industry_text: P&D Department, FATA Secretariat & Government of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa · Government
data.heading: Large-Scale Governance Feedback Survey
data.description:
A proactive survey of around 16,000 citizens that helped government stakeholders review and strengthen service delivery.

Our Solution & Results

We identified active subscribers across telecom networks, selected respondents at random and ran structured interviews through our call centre. A dedicated survey application recorded each response and managed data collection.

The client received structured datasets, call recordings and summary reports to assess trust levels and target improvements in governance and accountability.
data.challenge_description: Officials needed direct citizen feedback across selected tehsils and sub-divisions to see where governance and services were working, and where they were not.

data.title: Youth Skills & Employability Baseline Study
data.short_description: A baseline survey assessing the education, skills and job readiness of 1,000 students across Balochistan.
data.heading: Youth Skills & Employability Baseline Study
data.description:
A baseline survey assessing the education, skills and job readiness of 1,000 students across Balochistan.

Our Solution & Results

We built a stratified sampling framework and combined CATI telephone interviews with field operations. Supervisors monitored interviews live, ran validation checks and cleaned data daily with range and logic checks.

The client received a clean, validated dataset and an analytical brief, giving it a strong evidence base for targeted skills programmes and future progress tracking.
data.challenge_description: The client needed a reliable starting benchmark to design skills programmes, including for students in hard-to-reach rural districts.

data.heading: 3.5x Return on Ad Spend for an Online Gift Store
data.description:
A performance marketing campaign that grew an e-commerce brand's traffic, conversions and ad returns within 60 days.

Our Solution & Results

We ran targeted campaigns on Meta and Google Ads, supported by landing page optimisation and structured A/B testing. Refined audience segments and creative storytelling strengthened the brand's positioning.
